stories.title: Australia claims it is a global pioneer in preventing online harm – should other countries follow suit?
stories.summary: Australia is presenting itself as a global pioneer in preventing online harm as Prime Minister Anthony Albanese travels to the United States to discuss social-media reform. The Guardian considers whether other countries should follow Australia’s approach and portrays the initiative as leadership from a smaller nation.
